title: 2367. Number of Arithmetic Triplets

examples.explanation: (1, 2, 4) is an arithmetic triplet because both 7 - 4 == 3 and 4 - 1 == 3. (2, 4, 5) is an arithmetic triplet because both 10 - 7 == 3 and 7 - 4 == 3.
(0, 2, 4) is an arithmetic triplet because both 8 - 6 == 2 and 6 - 4 == 2. (1, 3, 5) is an arithmetic triplet because both 9 - 7 == 2 and 7 - 5 == 2.
